name: Wild thyme
note: Wild thyme, Thymus drucei: a low woody creeping mat of tiny scented leaves on the driest sand, covered in small pink-purple heads through summer; a bee plant. How it spreads: its woody stems creep over the sand and root where they touch down, so a cushion widens slowly outward and neighbouring cushions merge into drifts; its few seeds are carried a short way by ants in late summer. It needs the thinnest, driest turf and is shaded out where the grass closes (shadedBy), so it holds the open sand and leaves the grassy patches to clover. In the game: a cushion widens about a meter every four or five days in spring and summer, slower in autumn, and rests in winter (evergreen, low and dark); a seed starts a new cushion a few meters off now and then from late summer. A mat: a cover plant (recipes/world/growth.json cover), so a share per square meter rather than plants one by one (src/world/growth/cover.js matHour), drawn as a low carpet of stacked shells (mat-shells.wgsl, src/render/passes/mats.js). A machair plant of the meadow islet (B3a, Matt's pick of October 31, 2026): it comes only with the islet, planted as clumps on its turf when it rises (recipes/land/meadow-islet.json starters), never volunteers and is not in the Plant tool, so it stays the islet's own. habitat: shoreM is height above mean sea level; sand the painted sand share. growth: each square fills ratePerH of the gap toward how well the mat likes the ground each game hour, times seasonRate [spring, summer, autumn, winter] (it rests in winter). spread: planted (only ever planted, so its map is absent until the first clump); it creeps only into a square beside one at least fromShare full; with chance jumpPerH an hour, times jumpSeason (seed is set after flowering), a seed lands 2 to jumpM meters off a stand (jumpTries landings tried) and starts a patch jumpStart of full where the ground suits it at least jumpMinSuit; plantStart is how full a planted square starts; shadedBy lowers its target where the painted turf is thick (grass shades it out); grassYield is how much the grass gives way where it is full. Mats share the ground: one never grows past the room the others leave, and the first to hold a square keeps it. mat (the look, findable scale, about 1.5 times real): heightM the carpet's height at full cover; leafM the size of one leaf clump in the pattern; flowerM the size of a flower spot and flowerShare how many of the top spots flower while in flower (flowering, in season units 0 spring .. 4); edgeM the size of the wobble at a patch's edge; farTint how much its flowers tint it far off while in flower (from above it reads as a drift of their color); flowerR a flower head's radius as a share of its spot; stepLeaf how far one step of the march through a gap between copies may reach across the ground, in leaf clumps (smaller is smoother and costs more at a low look). season: physical albedo (linear) per season, blended through the year; flower the flowers' albedo. dormant: in season units, when it sits low and dark.
